title: Diamond
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='g1' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#9ff5ff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#3ec9e8'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='g2' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#7fe8fa'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#2aa9cc'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='g3' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#d8fbff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#8feefc'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- girdle band -->
  <polygon points='18,40 82,40 70,54 30,54' fill='#6fd8ef'/>
  <!-- crown facets -->
  <polygon points='18,40 50,18 82,40 50,40' fill='url(#g1)'/>
  <polygon points='18,40 50,18 50,40' fill='url(#g3)'/>
  <polygon points='82,40 50,18 50,40' fill='url(#g2)'/>
  <!-- crown table highlight -->
  <polygon points='38,32 50,24 62,32 50,36' fill='#e8fdff'/>

  <polygon points='30,54 70,54 50,88' fill='url(#g2)'/>

  <polygon points='30,54 50,54 50,88' fill='#5ecbe6'/>
  <polygon points='70,54 50,54 50,88' fill='#2f9fc0'/>
  <polygon points='30,54 38,54 50,88' fill='#a5f2fd'/>
  <polygon points='70,54 62,54 50,88' fill='#79e2f5'/>
  <!-- sparkle -->
  <polygon points='76,20 78,26 84,28 78,30 76,36 74,30 68,28 74,26' fill='#f4feff'/>
  <polygon points='24,26 25.5,29.5 29,31 25.5,32.5 24,36 22.5,32.5 19,31 22.5,29.5' fill='#d0f8ff'/>
</svg>
